claim: The umbrellas of the courtyards open and close automatically in response to the weather.
note: Installed 2010 (250 umbrellas, about 143,000 m2) — see sources.verified.json city #55.

claim: The mosque has ten minarets; of the original minarets only two survive: the main (Ra'isiyyah) minaret and the minaret of Bab as-Salam.
'Do not set out on a journey except for three mosques: al-Masjid al-Haram, the mosque of the Messenger, and al-Masjid al-Aqsa.'
'One prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers in any other mosque, except al-Masjid al-Haram.'
King Fahd's expansion began in 1985 and was completed in the early 1990s; the mosque grew to more than 160,000 m2.
